facts.text: Reed, dinner is at six. Bring the baby, bring the plan, and leave the equations at the door.
facts.why: The Sunday dinner scene found has Reed and Sue arriving a little late, with Ben noticing Sue is pregnant. Franklin is not born until the trip home from space, so 'bring the baby' does not fit that dinner.
facts.fix: Reed, Sunday dinner is at six. Ben and Johnny will be at the table already, so for once don't be late.

vibe.verdict: A fun retro dinner table with 1960s dishes, but the photo on the second page is cropped badly and the film's biggest moments are missing.
missing: Sunday dinner where Ben guesses Sue is pregnant
Franklin born on the trip home from space
Johnny working out the Silver Surfer's language
Sue standing up to the protesters with baby Franklin
The teleport bridges and Times Square
Shalla-Bal pushing Galactus into the portal
ideas: Swap 'Space race glazed meatloaf' note ('the space race era') for the Sunday dinner scene.
Swap 'Galactus-sized jelly mould' for 'Galactus's hunger' jelly shot.
Re-crop the second page photo so the cast is not pushed to the right edge.
Swap 'Cherry lime rickey' note for Sue's talk to the protesters.
